inlines.v: INHIBI'TION, noun [Latin inhibitio.] 1. Prohibition; restraint; embargo. 2. In law, a writ to forbid or inhibit a judge from farther proceedings in a cause depending before him; commonly, a writ issuing from a higher ecclesiastical court to an inferior one, on appeal.
